prompt: # CODING AGENT PROMPT — Op Art Landing Page (1960s Optical Art) **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build a complete, production-ready landing page on the first attempt. The condensed source spec is embedded below. Where the source spec conflicts with the mandatory rules in Sections 1–4, the mandatory rules win; every such conflict is resolved with an explicit one-line exception clause inline. Reference specification: `references/00-flagship-implementation-specs/op-art.md`. **Mission:** A single-page landing site in the **Op Art / Optical Art (1960s)** style — Bridget Riley's *Movement in Squares*, Victor Vasarely's concentric targets. Near-monochrome, high-contrast vibration: precise repeating black/near-white stripes, concentric rings, graduated square grids; illusions of motion, depth, and warping; mechanical, hypnotic precision. One sanctioned chromatic accent: signal red `#e10600`. All optical patterns must be pure CSS (repeating gradients) — no raster images anywhere on the page. **Copy:** Invent one coherent fictional brand (suggested: **OPTIKA**, a precision pattern-design engine for the web) and write all user-facing copy in **English** — real, on-theme copy for every section. Lorem ipsum is forbidden. Keep the brand name consistent across nav, hero, pricing, and footer. --- ## Theme Direction & Design Tokens **Mandatory token mapping** — define in `:root` (light) and override in both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class on `` (place the `.dark` block after the media query so explicit user choice wins): | Token | Light value | Dark value | Usage | |---|---|---|---| | `--bg-primary` | `#fefefe` | `#0a0a0a` | Page background | | `--bg-secondary` | `#f0f0f0` | `#1c1c1c` | Alternate bands, input fills | | `--text-primary` | `#0a0a0a` | `#fefefe` | Headings, body | | `--text-secondary` | `#4a4a4a` | `#b0b0b0` | Muted copy | | `--primary` | `#0a0a0a` | `#fefefe` | Primary fills, pattern ink | | `--secondary` | `#e10600` | `#ff453a` | Accent: badges, focus rings, CTA highlights | | `--text-error` / `--border-error` | `#e10600` | `#ff5147` | Error states | | `--text-success` / `--border-success` | `#0f6b3f` | `#35d07f` | Success states | | `--border-default` | `#0a0a0a` | `#fefefe` | All structural borders (3px standard) | | `--radius-sm` / `--radius-md` / `--radius-lg` | `0px` | `0px` | Precise geometry, no softness | | `--radius-pill` | `999px` | `999px` | Badges only | | `--shadow-sm` / `--shadow-md` / `--shadow-lg` | `0 0 0 transparent` / `0 6px 0 #0a0a0a` / `0 10px 0 #0a0a0a` | flip ink to `#fefefe` | Hard offset shadows | | `--z-dropdown` / `--z-modal` / `--z-toast` | `40` / `50` / `60` | same | Layering (add `--z-nav: 30` for sticky nav) | | `--spacing-gap` | `24px` | same | Default flex gap (extend with the `--space-1…24` scale) | | `--transition-fast` / `--transition-normal` | `120ms` / `240ms` | same | All state changes | | `--ease-standard` | `steps(6, end)` | same | Mechanical stepped easing | **Pattern tokens** (define as CSS variables so dark mode can invert the ink): `--stripe-pattern` (90° repeating, 6px `#0a0a0a` / 6px `#fefefe`), `--stripe-pattern-tight` (3px pitch), `--concentric-pattern` (repeating-radial, 4px rings). **Exception (no-pure-white rule):** the source spec's `#ffffff` is replaced by `#fefefe` everywhere, including inside pattern gradients — the delta is imperceptible and optical vibration is preserved. **Contrast pairing (enforced in both modes):** `--bg-primary` always pairs with `--text-primary`; `--bg-secondary` pairs with `--text-primary`; any element filled with `--primary` uses `--bg-primary` as its text color (they co-invert, so pairing survives theme switching). Never hardcode a text color against a token fill. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - Target everything via class/ID selectors; keep HTML semantic and styling-agnostic (no presentational markup, no wrapper divs whose only job is styling). - Reskinning the page must require editing `style.css` only. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** - Every color, radius, shadow, spacing, transition, easing, and z-index value must come from the token table above. Zero raw hex values in component rules. - Extended tokens: `--font-base`, `--font-display`, `--font-mono`, the `--text-xs…--text-5xl` scale, the `--space-1…--space-24` scale, and the three pattern tokens. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode** - Dark tokens defined under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and `.dark` (class block last, so it wins). - Patterns invert in dark mode (near-white ink on near-black); hard shadows flip to near-white offsets. - Visible theme toggle in the nav: Material Symbol `dark_mode`/`light_mode`, correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode"). Persist choice in `localStorage`; on first visit fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`. - The source spec declares no modes — you must validate the finished page in **both light and dark** before considering it complete (see Section 5). **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** - Build all layout structures with Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (the only sanctioned exceptions: footer link columns and pricing/feature card tops use `flex-start`). - Mobile-first: multi-column rows become single columns below 768px. No horizontal scrolling at any width from 320px up — solve root causes with `max-width: 100%` and contained patterns, not by hiding overflow. **1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration** - Use Tailwind CSS via the Play CDN `` for structural utilities only (flex, gaps, wrapping, max-widths, responsive prefixes). Do not add a Tailwind config script. - All color, typography, and component styling is done in `style.css` via BEM classes bound to CSS variables. Tailwind color utilities and arbitrary-value utilities with hex values are forbidden. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** - Load Google Fonts via ``: **Jost** (geometric, Futura-equivalent) bound to `--font-display`, **Inter** (Helvetica Neue–equivalent) bound to `--font-base`, **Space Mono** bound to `--font-mono`. - **Exception (Google Fonts rule):** the source's Futura/Helvetica Neue stacks are replaced by these Google-hosted equivalents; the historical names may remain only as fallbacks inside the font stacks. - Icons: Google Material Symbols Outlined stylesheet; icons rendered as `…`. Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden. - Display headings: `--font-display`, uppercase, tight letter-spacing. Eyebrow labels and step numerals: `--font-mono`, uppercase, wide letter-spacing. --- ## 2. COMPONENT & SECTION SPECIFICATIONS **2.1 Buttons (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--inverse`, `.btn--danger`)** - Default: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` 3px `--border-default`, hard `--shadow-md`, minimum 44×44px touch target, `--font-base` 700. - Hover: solid inversion (`--primary` fill, `--bg-primary` text) plus a 6px stripe band via `border-image: var(--stripe-pattern)`. **Exception (a11y override):** the source's stripe-fill hover with a white label fails contrast — do not implement it; use the inversion + stripe band instead. - Focus: `:focus-visible` → 3px `--secondary` outline, 3px offset. - Active: `transform: scale(0.97)`. - Loading (`.is-loading` + `aria-busy="true"`): interactions disabled, double-clicks prevented, a rotating hollow **square** spinner (3px border, `--radius-lg`) replaces the icon without changing button dimensions. - Disabled: `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. - Success/Error (`.is-success`, `.is-error`): temporary states driven by `--text-success`/`--text-error` with a Material Symbol `check`/`error` icon swap. - `.btn--danger` must be defined in the CSS library (red accent treatment, distinct in both modes) even if unused on this page. **2.2 Cards (`.card`, variants `--inverted`, `--tier`, `--quote`)** - Default: `--bg-secondary` or `--bg-primary` surface, 3px `--border-default`, `--shadow-md`, `::before` top band of `--stripe-pattern` (10px), `overflow: hidden`, flex column. - Hover: `translateY(-2px)` + `--shadow-lg`. - `:focus-within`: border switches to `--secondary`. - Define `.skeleton` (shimmer animation, no layout jump) and `.empty-state` (Material Symbol + guidance text) classes in the CSS library. **2.3 Forms & Inputs (`.input-group`, `.input`, `.input-group__error`)** - Structure: flex column wrapping `
